decisions.reason: The monk uses 壓良為賤 as a pointed accusation after the master's warning against mistaking a slave for the master; the reply then answers that accusation through the 柳下惠 allusion. In an independent case-commentary witness, 不是壓良為賤，也要緇素分明 explicitly treats the same expression as a verdict to be denied. The headword therefore names the recurrent fault of unjustly lowering the worthy, rather than merely describing social status.

The paired verbs carry the sermon's challenge even without relying on duplicate transmissions of this same address.
